newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - SRI LANKA NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SRI LANKA NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Sri Lankan political and business stories prepared for Reuters by NewsWatch, Colombo Tel/Fax: 94-1-735182 Internet: lucien@eureka.lk.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
DAILY NEWS
COLOMBO STOCK EXCHANGE LAUNCHES SCREEN BASED TRADING
Sri Lanka's 101-year-old Colombo Stock Exchange launches fully automated screen based trading system capable of handling 20,000 transactions every day.
THE ISLAND
MILITARY FOILS TAMIL TIGER REBELS RECRUITMENT

The security forces carried out a special operation to foil attempts by Tamil Tiger rebels to recruit youth from displaced families awaiting transport from the northeast port town of Trincomalee to northern Jaffna.
THINAKKURUL
UNHCR TO RENEW TALKS WITH TAMIL REBELS ON SHIPPING SERVICE

The UNHCR is to renew talks with Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) to resume shipping services to the Jaffna peninsula which have been disrupted since a passenger ferry was torched in July, officials said. The Tigers turned down an earlier request made to them by the UNHCR on the grounds that the U.N. agency did not sympathise with earlier returnees reported missing and the present plight of refugees.
LANKADEEPA
COMPENSATION CLAIMED BY CHINESE CONSTRUCTION COMPANY

China National Complete Plant Import & Export Corporation, which won the contract for constructing a 10 storey building for Colombo's Lady Ridgeway Children's Hospital is claiming 40 million rupees in damages for a 17 month delay in handing over the building site to them. The project is funded by a 420 million rupee concessionary loan from the Chinese government. The delay has been caused by the suspension of the demolition of the existing building.
VIRAKESARI
GOVERNMENMT RAISES WHEAT FLOUR AND BREAD PRICES

The government has raised the price of wheat flour by two rupees per kilogram and the price of a loaf of bread by 75 cents. The Food Commissioner said the price hike was due to an increase in the price of flour in the world market.
DIVAINA
SRI LANK'S SPRINT QUEEN TO GET ONE MILLION RUPEES

Susanthika Jayasinghe, Sri Lanka's sprint queen who won a silver medal at the recently concluded World Athletic Championships in Athens, will receive one million rupees in cash or property, Sports Minister S. B. Dissanayake said.
VIRAKESARI
NAVY ESCORT PASSENGER SHIP TO NORTH

The Sri Lanka navy escorted a passenger ship, "Tharaki," carrying 293 Tamil refugees from the northwestern port of Talai-Mannar to northern Kankensanthurai. The service resumed after a month. More than 3,500 displaced persons are in refugee camps in Mannar awaiting passage to the north.
